newsitem.title: USA: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 856 contracts.
newsitem.headline: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 856 contracts.

text.p: The Chicago Board of Trade Project A overnight agricultural trading volume totalled 856 contracts compared with 1,653 overnight Sunday, according to the CBOT.
There were 175 wheat, 346 corn, 287 soybean, 27 soyoil, 16 soymeal, one oat, three soybean options and one corn option traded.
In overnight trading, wheat was steady to one cent lower, corn was 1/4 cent higher to one cent lower and soybeans were steady to 2-1/4 cents higher.
